h1_acute_stress.event_trigger: Earliest timestamp t within regime where running_max_h1 >= 0.60 (T_PEAK_H1)

h2_acute_stress.event_trigger: Earliest timestamp t within regime where running_max_h2 >= 0.35 (T_PEAK_H2)

h1_recovery_confirmation.event_trigger: Earliest timestamp t > T_PEAK_H1 where (running_max_h1 - H1(t)) >= 0.15 (T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM_H1)
h1_recovery_confirmation.prospective_horizon: All forward opportunity, terminal events, and excursions measured strictly from T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM_H1 forward.

h2_recovery_confirmation.event_trigger: Earliest timestamp t > T_PEAK_H2 where (running_max_h2 - H2(t)) >= 0.15 (T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM_H2)
h2_recovery_confirmation.prospective_horizon: All forward opportunity, terminal events, and excursions measured strictly from T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM_H2 forward.

control_group_matching.description: To isolate the true recovery effect without immortal-time bias, compare regimes confirming recovery against non-recovering stressed regimes that survived to an identical elapsed duration from peak, or match on pre-recovery severity (prior peak hazard, pullback depth, regime age).
